version_metadata.description:
MindSprint is the premier executive book synthesis and cognitive intelligence platform, engineered for leaders, entrepreneurs, and high-performance thinkers.

While conventional apps condense books into superficial bullet points, MindSprint provides a revolutionary 3-Tier Depth Switcher:

1. THE SPARK (1 MINUTE): The core executive thesis, the 30-second bottom line, and 3 non-negotiable rules.
2. THE CORE (15 MINUTES): Chapter-by-chapter structural breakdowns, operational insights, and mental models.
3. THE MASTERCLASS (40 MINUTES): The definitive deep dive featuring dialectic critiques, author blind spots, counter-arguments from opposing scholars, real-world case studies, and an actionable implementation playbook.

INFINITE SYNTHESIS: Zero catalog limits. Synthesize any non-fiction book, biography, academic text, or ancient classic on demand with AI-assisted structural extraction.

STUDIO AUDIO NARRATION: Seamlessly listen with natural studio voices, customizable playback speeds (0.75x–2.0x), and synchronized transcript reading.

EXECUTIVE QUOTE STUDIO: Transform timeless wisdom into luxury, high-resolution cards ready for presentation decks or social sharing.
version_metadata.promotional_text: Executive book synthesis with infinite catalog access, 3-tier depth switcher, and studio audio narration.

app_review_information.review_notes:
Note to Reviewers (Guideline 4.2 Differentiation):
MindSprint is a dedicated executive intelligence and book synthesis platform designed for high-impact knowledge acquisition. It features a proprietary 3-Tier Depth Switcher (Spark 1-min, Core 15-min, Masterclass 40-min) allowing rapid executive decisions or deep academic synthesis.

Key Functionality:
1. 3-Tier Depth Architecture: Choose between rapid synthesis or rigorous dialectical critique.
2. Infinite Synthesis Engine: Synthesize any book, classic text, or academic work without catalogue paywalls.
3. Native Audio Narration: High-fidelity speech engine with multi-speed scrubbing and background audio playback.
4. Quote Studio: High-resolution visual card export for slide decks and reference.

Reviewer Test Guide:
• No sign-in or account creation required.
• Select any executive summary from the home library (e.g., Deep Work, Thinking Fast and Slow, The Republic).
• Switch between Spark, Core, and Masterclass tabs to evaluate multi-depth content.
• Tap 'Listen' to verify audio playback and speed controls.
